caption:
What does it take to make sure that the clean energy transition leaves no young person behind?
 
Today, I'm proud to launch the NextGen Energy Champions Initiative — a partnership between UNDP and Goodwall to connect young people across the Global South with the skills, knowledge, and opportunities of the clean energy transition.
 
The numbers tell a clear story. An accelerated energy transition could add up to 40 million jobs in the energy sector by 2050, with 18 million in renewables alone. But 67% of youth believe that they lack the technical skills to benefit from the digital and green economies that they are in the position to shape.
 
We can close that gap. And it starts by meeting young people where they are.
 
As a first step, through gamified learning on the Goodwall platform, youth aged 16 to 30 from any country of the world are being invited to:
 
→ Watch curated videos on clean energy technology, policy, and careers
 
→ Complete knowledge quizzes
 
→ Record a 30-second video sharing their perspective on #CleanEnergy

Their voices will shape our work — including a major convening on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly this September.
 
A just energy transition isn't built for young people. It is built with them.
 
If you're 16 to 30: download Goodwall and join the challenge.
 
If you work with youth: please share this post.
